storyCG.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: story CG key art for the ORIGINAL Unity 2D fantasy game Naki Legend. Create a wide cinematic 16:9 LANDSCAPE illustration called 'The Wind Brings Rain Home' (do NOT render any title or text). This is a high-detail painted CG, NOT pixel art. A brave young teenage adventurer with tousled navy-black hair, short cobalt-blue cloak/scarf with gold clasp, ivory tunic, brown gloves/boots and a sheathed modest silver sword stands in three-quarter back view beside a reopened ancient sandstone irrigation channel in a desert oasis village. His open palm catches the very first gentle raindrops; his posture conveys relief, kindness and quiet hope, not triumph or conquest. A small retrieved turquoise spiral WIND stone glows softly in his other hand, no giant magic beam. The background remains a beautiful REAL DESERT with dunes, weathered wind-carved stone, a few date palms and sparse hardy desert shrubs; the oasis is recovering only around existing water channels, NOT turning into a jungle. A small child and an elderly villager in simple fictional desert garments watch clear water begin to trickle into a shallow stone basin. In the far distance coastal rain clouds finally cross the ridge, parted dry storm haze yields to muted blue sky, slanting warm sunset light catches fresh raindrops and wet sandstone. Natural motifs of air, moisture, wind vane, waterwheel and new tiny seedlings; sparse life is precious. Strong emotional composition, generous environmental space, original fantasy anime illustration with painterly textures, restrained gold/sand/blue/teal color harmony. Keep all people fully clothed, no combat, no dead creatures, no emblems from existing franchises, no text, no interface, no captions. Leave the lower 15% visually quiet for a future dialogue overlay.
